subject.title: Android: Enter key should send message when physical keyboard is connected

question: Should maintainers close or supersede https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/101289 before promoting a narrow follow-up for this issue's repeat/key-up edge?
rationale: An open contributor PR still references this issue, but current main already superseded its central useful change and the reopened bug is a narrower sequence-handling problem in the shared helper.

options.title: Use a fresh narrow follow-up
options.body: Close or supersede the older contributor PR and fix the remaining repeat/key-up behavior directly in the shared Android hardware-key helper with updated proof.

options.title: Repair the contributor PR
options.body: Keep https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/101289 as the vehicle only if it is rebased and changed to address the current shared-helper sequence bug with real Android proof.

recommendation.title: Use a fresh narrow follow-up
recommendation.body: Close or supersede the older contributor PR and fix the remaining repeat/key-up behavior directly in the shared Android hardware-key helper with updated proof.

likelyOwner.reason: joshavant is assigned to the issue and supplied the live E2E evidence for the exact remaining edge case.
